# BDBSA taxa: `bio_bdbsa_taxa`

If a taxa was not recognised by the Biological Databases of South Australia ([BDBSA](https://www.environment.sa.gov.au/topics/science/information-and-data/biological-databases-of-south-australia)) (after [taxonomic alignment](#taxonomy)) all records of that taxa were sent to the next highest taxonomic level, i.e. species level records not recognised in BDBSA were sent to genus, and unrecognised subspecies records sent to species. Sending unrecognised subspecies records to species enables the [Binomial to trinomial](#btt) process to allocate the correct trinomial (subspecies), rather than simply filtering (and losing) the record entirely.
